ideas.name: Startup Funding Navigator

ideas.name: Hobbyist Hardware Hub

ideas.monetization: Freemium with optional paid tiers for enhanced project storage, marketplace integration for component sourcing, and community support features ($5/month).

ideas.name: Product Feedback Loop
ideas.problem: Consumers often have valuable feedback on products but lack a direct, structured channel to provide it to companies, especially for smaller or indie products. This app allows users to give structured feedback and track its impact.
ideas.monetization: Subscription service for businesses to access aggregated feedback data and analytics ($99/month for basic, $499/month for premium).
